purpose: Determines the best front-end offer strategy to attract new customers based on the user's business model, margins, capacity, and goals. Based on Alex Hormozi's $100M Offers framework.
when_to_use: User wants to create or improve their front-end customer acquisition offer
User is struggling with lead generation or conversion on their entry-level product
User asks about attraction offers, front-end offers, or customer acquisition strategies
when_not_to_use: User already has a working front-end offer and wants to optimise upsells (use Upsell flow)
User needs to choose lead generation channels (use Leads Strategy flow)
User wants to create a free lead magnet (use Lead Magnet flow)

questions.agent_context: This determines which offer structures are viable. Physical products have different constraints (shipping, COGS) than digital products or services. Hybrid models have the most flexibility.
questions.if_unknown: Ask what they spend most of their time doing for customers. If they deliver a service in person or on calls, it's coaching/consulting. If they ship something, it's physical product. If customers log in to use it, it's SaaS.
